examples.en: That makes sense — the cache key includes the tenant id, so the entries never collide.
examples.zh: 这就说得通了，缓存键里带了租户 id，所以永远不会撞。

situation.en: Ah, that makes sense now. Thanks for explaining.
situation.zh: 同事给你讲清了一个设计，你想说这下懂了。

entries.zh: 说得通、有道理；讲得通（听懂了逻辑）

examples.en: You have been staring at that stack trace for an hour — take a break.
examples.zh: 你盯着那个栈信息已经一小时了，休息一下吧。

situation.en: Let's take a break and come back to this with fresh eyes.
situation.zh: 团队卡在一个问题上，你建议先休息一下。

examples.en: I take notes on every incident, or I forget the details within a week.
examples.zh: 每次故障我都记笔记，不然一周内就忘光细节了。

situation.en: Give me a second to take notes so I don't miss anything.
situation.zh: 开会时你想让对方稍等，你记一下。

examples.en: Could you take a look at my pull request when you have a minute?
examples.zh: 你有空的时候能看一下我的 PR 吗？

situation.en: I'll take a look at the logs tonight and update the ticket.
situation.zh: 同事报了个问题，你说你来看看。

entries.zh: 看一下（请人看或自己看）

examples.en: We still keep in touch with two people from the old team.
examples.zh: 我们还和老团队的两个人保持着联系。

situation.en: Let's keep in touch — good luck with the new role.
situation.zh: 同事要离职了，你想留个联系。

examples.en: She is in charge of the whole release process now.
examples.zh: 她现在负责整个发布流程。

situation.en: Who's in charge of the on-call schedule this month?
situation.zh: 你想问这个月的值班表谁负责。

examples.en: I am on my way — the train was delayed by ten minutes.
examples.zh: 我在路上了，火车晚了十分钟。

situation.en: On my way, see you at the office in twenty.
situation.zh: 同事在群里问你到哪了，你回一句在路上。

examples.en: By the way, the demo environment resets every night at two.
examples.zh: 顺便说一下，演示环境每天凌晨两点会重置。

situation.en: By the way, your talk last week was great.
situation.zh: 聊天快结束时你想起要夸一下同事上周的分享。

examples.en: At the end of the day, users do not care which framework we picked.
examples.zh: 说到底，用户并不在乎我们选了哪个框架。

entries.note: 这里是“归根结底”的比喻义，不是字面的“在一天结束时”。

situation.en: At the end of the day, reliability beats clever code.
situation.zh: 争论方案时你想给讨论收个口。

entries.term: at the end of the day

examples.en: Let's keep the old flow for now and revisit it after the launch.
examples.zh: 先保留旧流程，上线之后再回头改。

situation.en: For now, just restart it when it leaks — a real fix is planned.
situation.zh: 你向用户交代一个临时处理办法。

examples.en: Once in a while we still deploy on a Friday, but only small changes.
examples.zh: 偶尔我们还是会在周五发布，但只发小改动。

situation.en: I still write Java once in a while, mostly for old services.
situation.zh: 面试聊技术栈时，你说某个语言偶尔还会用。

examples.en: Everyone is in a hurry before the freeze, so reviews take longer, not shorter.
examples.zh: 封版前大家都赶时间，评审反而更慢了。

situation.en: Sorry, I'm in a bit of a hurry — can we catch up after standup?
situation.zh: 走廊里同事拉住你聊天，你赶时间。

examples.en: The build finished just on time for the demo.
examples.zh: 构建刚好赶在演示之前完成。

entries.note: on time 是“按计划的时间点”，in time 是“来得及（赶在截止前）”，区别见下一条。

situation.en: Please be on time — the client joins at ten sharp.
situation.zh: 你提醒同事开会别迟到。

examples.en: He caught the bug in time, right before the release went out.
examples.zh: 他在发布出去之前及时发现了这个 bug。

situation.en: We found the data issue just in time.
situation.zh: 你在复盘里说还好发现得及时。

entries.zh: 及时、来得及（赶在出事之前）

examples.en: I was about to deploy when the alert went off.
examples.zh: 我正要发布，告警就响了。

situation.en: I was about to message you about the same thing.
situation.zh: 同事刚发来消息，你想说你正要找他说这事。

examples.en: The cache is supposed to expire after an hour, but it clearly does not.
examples.zh: 缓存本该在一小时后过期的，但显然没有。

entries.note: be supposed to 是“按规定/预期应该”，口头上也常用来吐槽“说好的是这样，结果不是”。

situation.en: Aren't we supposed to freeze changes this week?
situation.zh: 你质疑为什么封版周还在改东西。

examples.en: I would rather ship a smaller scope than slip the date again.
examples.zh: 我宁愿缩小范围，也不想再延期了。

entries.note: would rather 后面接动词原形：I'd rather stay。说别人的愿望是 would rather someone did（用过去式）。

situation.en: I'd rather review it tomorrow morning with a clear head.
situation.zh: 晚上很累了，你想说明早再评审这个方案。

examples.en: No wonder the queries are slow — there is no index on that column.
examples.zh: 难怪查询慢，那一列上没有索引。

situation.en: No wonder you're tired — you were on call all weekend.
situation.zh: 同事一脸疲惫，你得知原因后恍然大悟。

entries.zh: 难怪（知道原因后不奇怪了）

examples.en: Did you leave that flag on on purpose, or was it an accident?
examples.zh: 那个开关你是故意开着的，还是不小心？

situation.en: I skipped the test on purpose — it needs the staging data first.
situation.zh: 评审人问你为什么跳过一个测试，你解释是故意的。

examples.en: I deployed to production by mistake instead of staging.
examples.zh: 我误把代码发到了生产环境，本来是想发预发。

situation.en: Sorry, I closed your ticket by mistake — reopening it now.
situation.zh: 你误关了别人的工单，道个歉。

examples.en: We can go through the trade-offs in detail during the design review.
examples.zh: 我们可以在设计评审时详细过一遍这些取舍。

situation.en: Happy to explain in detail after standup.
situation.zh: 站会时间不够，你说会后再细讲。

examples.en: It failed twice, but it was the right call after all.
examples.zh: 它失败了两次，但事后看这个决定没错。

entries.note: after all 还有一个用法：别忘了、毕竟：He is a junior after all. 他毕竟是个新人。

situation.en: Thanks for covering my shift — I owe you one after all.
situation.zh: 你事后感谢同事替你值班。

entries.zh: 毕竟；事后证明还是（和起初以为的不同）

examples.en: The migration will take at least three days, probably more.
examples.zh: 这次迁移至少要三天，可能更久。

situation.en: At least the rollback worked — nobody noticed the bad deploy.
situation.zh: 复盘时你说不幸中的万幸是回滚成功了。

entries.zh: 至少（下限）；好歹（安慰的说法）

examples.en: Sooner or later, that manual step will cause an incident.
examples.zh: 那个手动步骤迟早会闯祸。

situation.en: We'll have to rewrite it sooner or later.
situation.zh: 技术债讨论里你说这个迟早要重写。

examples.en: All of a sudden, traffic tripled and the alerts started firing.
examples.zh: 突然之间流量涨到三倍，告警全响了。

situation.en: All of a sudden the room went quiet when the CEO walked in.
situation.zh: 你讲一个公司里的趣事，气氛突然安静了。

examples.en: These days, most of my work is reviews and design docs, not code.
examples.zh: 最近我的工作大多是评审和设计文档，不怎么是写代码了。

situation.en: These days I mostly work from home.
situation.zh: 闲聊时你说最近的工作状态。

examples.en: She takes care of all the vendor contracts for the team.
examples.zh: 团队所有的供应商合同都是她在管。

situation.en: Don't worry about the venue — I'll take care of it.
situation.zh: 筹备活动时你主动揽下一件事。

examples.en: Take advantage of the quiet week to pay down some tech debt.
examples.zh: 趁这周不忙，把技术债还掉一些。

entries.note: take advantage of 也可以是贬义的“占便宜、利用某人”，靠语境区分。

situation.en: New hires should take advantage of the mentoring program.
situation.zh: 你建议新人好好利用导师计划。

examples.en: Everyone on the team takes part in the on-call rotation.
examples.zh: 团队每个人都参与值班轮换。

situation.en: I'd love to take part in the hackathon this year.
situation.zh: 你想报名参加公司的黑客松。

examples.en: Pay attention to the error budget when you plan the next quarter.
examples.zh: 规划下季度时要注意错误预算。

situation.en: Pay attention to this part — it's where most people get stuck.
situation.zh: 你给新人讲系统时提醒他注意关键处。

examples.en: I lose track of time when I am deep in a debugging session.
examples.zh: 我一沉浸在调试里就忘了时间。

situation.en: Sorry, I lost track of the thread — where were we?
situation.zh: 长会上你走神了，想拉回进度。

entries.zh: 跟丢、记不清（时间、进度、线索）

examples.en: The conference was expensive, but it was worth it for the contacts alone.
examples.zh: 大会很贵，但光是认识的人就值回票价了。

situation.en: It's a long migration, but it'll be worth it.
situation.zh: 你安慰队友：这次迁移虽然长，但值得。

examples.en: Make sure the feature flag is off before you merge.
examples.zh: 合并之前确认一下功能开关是关着的。

situation.en: Make sure to update the runbook after the incident.
situation.zh: 你提醒同事故障处理完记得更新手册。

examples.en: We are making progress on the migration — two of five services are done.
examples.zh: 迁移在推进了，五个服务已经完成两个。

situation.en: Slowly, but we're making progress.
situation.zh: 经理问进度，你说在推进、就是慢。

examples.en: A good error message makes a difference when you are debugging at 3 a.m.
examples.zh: 凌晨三点调试时，一条好的错误信息差别巨大。

situation.en: One senior hire can make a real difference to this team.
situation.zh: 你跟经理说招一个资深的人对团队帮助很大。

entries.zh: 起作用、有影响、带来改变

examples.en: Give the new editor a try for a week before you judge it.
examples.zh: 先用新编辑器试一周再下结论。

situation.en: Give it a try — worst case, we roll it back.
situation.zh: 你鼓励同事试一下新流程。

examples.en: Give me a call when the build finishes, whatever the result.
examples.zh: 构建跑完给我打个电话，不管结果如何。

situation.en: Give us a call if the issue comes back.
situation.zh: 你对用户说问题再出现就打电话。

examples.en: New hires often have trouble with the deployment pipeline in the first week.
examples.zh: 新人第一周常常会被发布流水线难住。

entries.note: have trouble 后接动名词：have trouble sleeping / have trouble with 名词。

situation.en: I'm having trouble with the VPN today.
situation.zh: 你跟 IT 支持说你今天连不上 VPN。

examples.en: I have to run some errands at lunch — bank, post office, that kind of thing.
examples.zh: 午休我得出去办几件事，银行、邮局之类的。

situation.en: I'll be late back from lunch — a few errands to run.
situation.zh: 你告诉同事午休会晚点回来。

entries.zh: 跑腿办事（银行、取快递这类杂事）

examples.en: In the long run, the rewrite will be cheaper than patching forever.
examples.zh: 长远看，重写比一直打补丁便宜。

situation.en: It hurts now, but in the long run the team will thank us.
situation.zh: 说服同事接受短期的痛、换长期的好。
